literal.prompt: Какая популярная аркадная ритм-игра предлагает танцевать, наступая на стрелки напольной платформы?

literalGroups.primaryGround: Lines 202 and 205: DDR became a globally popular rhythm-game franchise; players follow on-screen arrows corresponding to footpads.
literalGroups.locator: Lines 202 and 205: DDR became a globally popular rhythm-game franchise; players follow on-screen arrows corresponding to footpads.

literalGroups.literal: Правильный ответ — Dance Dance Revolution. Она появилась в японских аркадах в сентябре 1998 года: игроки следовали экранным стрелкам, соответствующим напольным панелям.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Line 205: DDR reached Japanese arcades in September 1998; players follow on-screen arrows corresponding to the game’s footpads.
literalGroups.locator: Line 205: DDR reached Japanese arcades in September 1998; players follow on-screen arrows corresponding to the game’s footpads.

literalGroups.literal: Dance Aerobics вышла для Nintendo Entertainment System в 1987 году и использовала Power Pad как танцевальную площадку.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Line 200: Dance Aerobics was developed in 1987 for the Nintendo Entertainment System and used the Nintendo Power Pad as a dance floor.
literalGroups.locator: Line 200: Dance Aerobics was developed in 1987 for the Nintendo Entertainment System and used the Nintendo Power Pad as a dance floor.

literalGroups.literal: PaRappa the Rapper (1996) помогла ритм-играм обрести популярность благодаря нажатию кнопок в такт музыке.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Line 201: PaRappa the Rapper (1996) helped bring electronic rhythm games popularity; players pressed buttons in time with music and received accuracy rankings.
literalGroups.locator: Line 201: PaRappa the Rapper (1996) helped bring electronic rhythm games popularity; players pressed buttons in time with music and received accuracy rankings.

literalGroups.literal: Beatmania — ритм-игра Konami 1997 года, где игрок выступает диджеем и следует экранным инструкциям.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Line 202: Konami entered the rhythm-game scene with Beatmania in 1997; the player acts as a club DJ following on-screen instructions.
literalGroups.locator: Line 202: Konami entered the rhythm-game scene with Beatmania in 1997; the player acts as a club DJ following on-screen instructions.

literalGroups.literal: В Европе Dance Dance Revolution также известна под названием Dancing Stage.

literalGroups.locator: Line 205: Dance Dance Revolution was also known as Dancing Stage in Europe.

entries.correctNoteNewFact: The correct note adds that Dance Dance Revolution was also known as Dancing Stage in Europe (The Strong, line 205), a fact absent from the prompt and key and directly identifying the same option.
entries.absoluteDifficulty: Keep frozen easy: the prompt asks for recognition of a widely known arcade rhythm-game mechanic rather than a date or specialized historical detail. The Strong describes DDR as globally popular and among history’s most recognizable rhythm games (lines 202, 205); adult players familiar with games can identify the distinctive dance-pad arrows. Distractors are other named rhythm/dance games, not absurd choices.
